entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ugh, she reeks of booze...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Haha, what a surprise. I thought you[n]were joking, yet here you are.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I respect that bravery, so I'll listen to what[n]you have to say. Well, what do you want[n]to know?
Why Shibuya's dangerous.
Who controls Shibuya.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Why that?
I have business there.
I need intel on their boss.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hm...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well I do happen to know something[n]about that. I could tell you, but...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Do you know the Phantom Thieves of[n]Hearts? You know, that case the public[n]has been focused on lately.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I was pursuing the issue of people[n]randomly entering into a shut-down[n]state, but I'm lacking intel...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: That's why I'm currently looking for[n]new material to write about.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So, do you have any info on these[n]Phantom Thieves?
Are those your terms?
Why're you asking me?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hm... Something like that.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You're a Shujin kid, right? I remember[n]you wearing their uniform the last time[n]we met.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I thought maybe you might have some[n]insider knowledge on the Phantom[n]Thieves because of it.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Their first incident was that of Kamoshida,[n]you know?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Ideally, I'd like to get some exclusive[n]coverage from a student who suffered[n]Kamoshida's abuse.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I would love an introduction if you know[n]of someone who fits the bill.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Seems both you and I can't really[n]do our stuff out in the open, so...[n]Whaddya say?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, a student who suffered from abuse...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Oh! What about that Mishima guy?[n]He always seems to be on the side of[n]the Phantom Thieves.
I know someone.
I accept your offer.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: It's a deal then. Send me your friend's[n]contact info later.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You'd better be thankful. My quick wit[n]is the only reason we're getting this far.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Now that I think about it, those mental[n]shutdowns and the Phantom Thieves[n]both seem supernatural...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Could they be related? Or am I just[n]hoping for a coincidence?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, sorry. I have a tendency to talk[n]to myself on occasion.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well then, you can't exactly consider this[n]an upfront payment, but...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: [clr 2]Junya Kaneshiro[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I think he's probably the guy you're[n]looking for.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yes!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You should check him out further if you're[n]curious... but I'm not responsible for what[n]happens next!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Lala-chan, can I get a refill for this kid?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: We need to make a toast to our new[n]acquaintance!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It'll be a problem if you stay too long.[n]You should leave right after you finish[n]your water...
